title: Initiative Velocity Mapping (IVM): time-phased prioritization for cost/latency-sensitive roadmaps
creator: Ethan Liu
description: Problem: Existing RICE-derived rubrics at Redwood surface static point-in-time scores that underweight time-phased value, rollout risk, and non-linear cost/latency tradeoffs for inference workloads. Goal: Design a lightweight, repeatable Initiative Velocity Mapping (IVM) framework that augments RICE with: 1) time-phased value (first 30/90/180d expected user value), 2) a cost-latency elasticity penalty term based on model and workload archetype, and 3) a velocity multiplier reflecting cross-team dependencies and rollout complexity. Deliverable: a scoring spreadsheet, a one-page PRD, a draft rubric for quarterly planning, and a small dashboard showing historical velocity vs. forecast. Success metrics: (a) 80% of prioritized initiatives have measurable 0/30/90d value targets; (b) PM+Eng satisfaction score for prioritization decisions improves by +0.4 on internal survey; (c) fewer late-scope escalations for Dedicated/Private rollouts.
comments: 2026-02-25 - Initial writeup: sketched IVM concept during roadmap sync. Hypothesis: blending time-phased impact and dynamic cost/latency penalty will reduce mis-prioritization of runtime-level work vs. surface-level feature work.

2026-03-02 - PM review (Connor Hughes): asked for concrete formula and normalization approach. Suggested we include an explicit treatment for 'non-linear cost events' (e.g., peak inference bursts) rather than only average cost.

2026-03-05 - Engineering feedback (Priya Anand): recommended pulling historical per-route latency and token-cost variance from Console to compute elasticity factors. Flagged that KV cache and batching make 'per-token cost' noisy; propose 90th-percentile cost as input.
2026-03-08 - Design sync (Alex Kim): will design a single-page scoring UI for the Console so PMs can see how changing latency penalty changes rank. Proposed color-coding for high-risk initiatives.
2026-03-10 - Data request: sent ticket to ENG-20657 (data-export:route-performance-90p) to provide aggregated metrics by route/model for last 12 months.
2026-03-12 - Stakeholder review (Revenue ops & Solutions): requested a matrix view mapping customer segments to time-phased value buckets; this will help calibrate "reach" and short-term ARR impact.
2026-03-14 - Draft rubric posted to Confluence (link below). Next: run a retrospective scoring exercise with three teams and compare final IVM ranks vs. historical RICE ranks.
Planned follow-ups: collect 3 sample initiatives from Dedicated, Console, and Runtime teams; run IVM scoring and produce a comparison memo (due 2026-03-28).
